items.title: File unfair dismissal claim (Kündigungsschutzklage) with the Labour Court
items.quote: Zu Ihrer Information: Eine Klage gegen diese Kündigung wäre innerhalb von drei Wochen nach Erhalt des Schreibens beim Arbeitsgericht einzureichen.
items.computation: The letter states it was personally handed over on 18.11.2026 in the presence of a witness, so receipt (Zugang) = Wednesday, 18.11.2026. §4 KSchG gives 3 weeks from receipt to file a Kündigungsschutzklage. Under §187(1) BGB the day of the triggering event (18.11.) is not counted, and under §188(2) BGB a period measured in weeks ends on the day of the last week whose name corresponds to the day on which the event occurred, i.e. again a Wednesday. 18.11. + 1 week = 25.11.; + 2 weeks = 02.12.; + 3 weeks = 09.12.2026 (Wednesday). 09.12.2026 is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in Rheinland-Pfalz, so no shift under §193 BGB applies.

items.title: Register as jobseeking (arbeitsuchend melden) with the Agentur für Arbeit
items.quote: Um Nachteile beim Arbeitslosengeld zu vermeiden, müssen Sie sich sofort bei der Agentur für Arbeit arbeitsuchend melden.
items.computation: Under §38(1) SGB III, an employee must register as jobseeking 3 months before the end of employment if that lead time is known; if less than 3 months' notice is given (as here: notice on 18.11.2026 for an end date of 31.01.2027, i.e. only about 2.5 months), the employee must instead register within 3 days of learning the end date. Knowledge/receipt = 18.11.2026 (Wednesday). Under §187(1) BGB the day of the event is excluded, so the 3-day count runs 19., 20., 21.11.2026. 21.11.2026 is a Saturday, so under §193 BGB the deadline shifts to the next business day, Monday 23.11.2026. This date has already passed relative to today (24.11.2026).

items.title: Employment relationship ends
items.quote: Wir kündigen deshalb das Arbeitsverhältnis ordentlich unter Einhaltung der gesetzlichen Frist zum 31.01.2027.
items.computation: The letter states the explicit termination date; no calculation needed.

warnings: The statutory 3-day deadline to register as jobseeking with the Agentur für Arbeit (derived from §38 SGB III, since less than 3 months' notice was given) falls on 23.11.2026, which is already in the past as of today (24.11.2026) — act immediately if this has not yet been done, as it can reduce unemployment benefits.

The letter does not use a Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung format but merely informs about the 3-week Kündigungsschutzklage deadline under §4 KSchG; this is a statutory deadline, not an extendable instruction from the employer, so it should be verified independently (e.g. with a lawyer or works council) rather than relied on solely from this letter.
